Spend 3 scraps repairing the drum rim (earn 37 gold)
Walk on as the soft drumbeat fades behind the mist

events.title: The Bedpost Thimble Lift
events.description: A stout button-eyed liftkeeper hauls a brass thimble up a giant bedpost on crossed red threads; the wooden rungs vanish into candlelit dark.

choices.text: Collect brass pulley shavings (+2 scraps)
Offer 2 scraps to oil the thimble lift (gain 28 gold)
Let the lift climb without you

events.title: The Shoe-Tongue Tollbooth
events.description: An enormous oxblood boot blocks the passage, its tongue folded into a toll desk while a round mismatched-eye cobbler threads the towering eyelets.

choices.text: Spend 1 scrap re-lacing the giant boot (gain 19 gold)
Pay 22 gold for four heel-thread bundles (+4 scraps)
Tiptoe past the boot's loose lace

events.title: The Keyhole Ribbon Windmill
events.description: Behind peeled wallpaper a bone-cream keyhole towers over the dolls; a squat velvet windkeeper turns a ribbon windmill inside the lock.

choices.text: Gather fallen ribbon tails (+1 scrap)
Pay 17 gold for three windmill spools (+3 scraps)
Leave the keyhole to its quiet wind

events.title: The Moonlit Darning Egg
events.description: A house-sized bone-cream darning egg lies cracked on a black quilt ledge; a tiny button-eyed mender gathers silver thread from its split seam beneath one amber candle.

choices.text: Collect stray silver stitches from the cracked egg (+2 scraps)
Spend 2 scraps sealing the great egg seam (earn 28 gold)
Leave the great egg beneath its pale quilt moon

events.title: The Velvet Curtain Pulley
events.description: Across a high window ledge, a carriage-wide plum curtain hangs from a groaning brass pulley; a round moth-cloaked doll steadies its stitched rope in wavering candlelight.

choices.text: Pay 16 gold for three coils of curtain braid (+3 scraps)
Spend 1 scrap repairing the brass guide (earn 21 gold)
Let the heavy curtain fall across the ledge

events.title: The Inkblack Hatpin Ladder
events.description: Five towering silver hatpins lean against an inkblack wardrobe door; a squat moss-velvet ladder keeper lashes their heads together with oxblood yarn as the candle gutters.

choices.text: Gather a loose hatpin cap (+1 scrap)
Pay 23 gold for four bundles of ladder lashing (+4 scraps)
Leave the hatpin ladder rattling against the wardrobe

events.title: The Squeaking Bed-Spring Bridge
events.description: A towering brass bed spring hangs across a cracked nursery floorboard like a swaying bridge; a plump button-eyed porter coils thread around its rattling hooks in amber lamplight.

choices.text: Gather two loose coils of stitching thread (+2 scraps)
Spend 2 scraps fastening the spring bridge (earn 28 gold)
Let the spring swing over the dark crack

events.title: The Forgotten Photograph Album
events.description: An enormous accordion photograph album lies open across a stair landing, stitched portraits slipping from its velvet pockets; a tiny oxblood archivist offers brass clasps to help rebind its spine.

choices.text: Trade 1 scrap of album corners for 17 gold
Pay 19 gold for three bundles of spine thread (+3 scraps)
Fold the giant album shut without disturbing its portraits

events.title: The Pencil-Ferry Crossing
events.description: A pencil longer than a bridge floats across a pool of spilled blue-black ink; a stubby moss-cloaked ferry keeper steers it with an oversized sewing needle under an amber candle.

choices.text: Gather a loose thread cuff around the pencil eraser (+1 scrap)
Pay 15 gold for two bundles of pencil-ferry binding (+2 scraps)
Wait for the pencil ferry to drift downstream

events.title: The Pepper-Mill Stairwell
events.description: A towering brass pepper mill stands open on a candlelit landing, its stepped grinder spiralling upward like a stairwell; a plump button-eyed miller doll winds the great crank, raining amber peppercorn dust onto the dolls below.

choices.text: Pay 18 gold for three bundles of copper-ground thread (+3 scraps)
Spend 1 scrap oiling the crank spindle (earn 21 gold)
Leave the pepper mill to its slow grinding

events.title: The Nutcracker Ward
events.description: A wardrobe-tall oxblood nutcracker doll stands sentry over a shelf of splinted ragdoll patients, cracking candle-warm walnuts with its brass jaws onto a moss-velvet counter.

choices.text: Gather two shells of walnut stitching (+2 scraps)
Spend 2 scraps bracing the nutcracker's aching jaws (earn 29 gold)
Leave the ward to its quiet cracking

events.title: The Sugar-Tongs Span
events.description: Two silver sugar tongs lie clasped tip to tip across a dark gap between table ledges, forming a narrow span; a round button-eyed sweetkeeper tests their cold hinge by amber candlelight.

choices.text: Gather a loose thread from the tongs' silver hinge (+1 scrap)
Pay 14 gold for two bundles of pincer binding (+2 scraps)
Leave the sugar-tong span to its cold shadow

events.title: The Shutter-Hook Signal
events.description: A towering nursery shutter swings over the ragdoll road; a squat oxblood watch doll holds an amber lantern beneath its giant brass hook while a red-thread warning bell taps the frame.

choices.text: Refasten the warning hook (spend 2 scraps; earn 29 gold)
Buy three coils of storm-hem thread (spend 16 gold; gain 3 scraps)
Leave the warning bell ringing into the night

events.title: The Ink-Ribbon Typewriter
events.description: House-sized typewriter keys rise from a puddle of midnight ink like stepping stones; a round button-eyed typist gathers torn plum ribbons in a single trembling candlebeam.

choices.text: Collect two loose ribbon windings (gain 2 scraps)
Retie the ink spool (spend 1 scrap; earn 20 gold)
Let the last typewriter key fall silent

events.title: The Cork-Lid Lookout
events.description: A saucer-wide cork stopper shelters a tiny moss-cloth sentry above a black inkwell; its stitched warning pennant hangs from an immense silver pin in the candlelit draft.

choices.text: Buy three strands of cork-lid lacing (spend 18 gold; gain 3 scraps)
Seal the sentry's leaking roof (spend 2 scraps; earn 31 gold)
Leave the pennant floating above the black ink

events.title: The Porcelain Doorbell
events.description: A cracked porcelain bell hangs above a giant cupboard door; a plump slate-blue latchkeeper in mismatched button boots holds its fallen red-thread pull cord under a wan candle.

choices.text: Mend the porcelain bell pull (spend 1 scrap; earn 22 gold)
Buy two braided bell cords (spend 12 gold; gain 2 scraps)
Pass the cupboard before the bell tolls

events.title: The Shadow-Stitch Zoetrope
events.description: An enormous brass zoetrope turns by itself on the floorboards; each slit shows four rag dolls marching under a thread-red moon while its button-eyed keeper grips the broken crank.

choices.text: Pay 19 gold for three bundles of frame-thread (+3 scraps)
Spend 2 scraps to retie the turning axle (earn 31 gold)
Let the fourth shadow finish its lonely circuit

events.title: The Hushglass Kaleidoscope
events.description: A fractured kaleidoscope as long as a bedpost leans over a black stairwell; its round plum-cloth keeper shows the party's stitched faces in shards that blink out of turn.

choices.text: Pay 14 gold for two bundles of lens-binding thread (+2 scraps)
Spend 1 scrap patching the broken eyepiece (earn 18 gold)
Leave the blinking fragments in the stairwell

events.title: The Crooked Sewing Compass
events.description: An ivory sewing compass lies on a quilt-map as large as the floor; its needle follows the party's loose thread instead of north while a slate-blue survey doll holds its hinge shut.

choices.text: Pay 22 gold for three bundles of survey thread (+3 scraps)
Spend 3 scraps binding the wandering needle (earn 42 gold)
Step away before the compass points after you

events.title: The Hushed Fob Watch
events.description: A brass fob watch hangs over a dark nursery stair like a pendulum moon; far below its cracked glass, a small oxblood watchkeeper winds the chain with mitten hands as one candle glows through the motionless gears.

choices.text: Pay 16 gold for three coils of watchspring thread (+3 scraps)
Spend 2 scraps rethreading the hanging chain (earn 27 gold)
Let the frozen hands keep their midnight secret

events.title: The Bonewhite Breadbox
events.description: A breadbox as broad as a cellar yawns open on the pantry floor; a round button-eyed baker in a flour-white hood counts lost spool crumbs behind its moonlit glass door while black lace hangs from the hinges.

choices.text: Pay 12 gold for two bundles of crumb-wrapped thread (+2 scraps)
Spend 1 scrap bracing the heavy breadbox hinge (earn 19 gold)
Close the glass door before the crumbs begin to move

events.title: The Silver Shoehorn Ramp
events.description: A tarnished shoehorn bridges two giant boot heels above a crack in the floorboards; its curved silver back shines in amber candlelight as a tiny plum-cloth cobbler tightens the worn leather grip.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps bracing the silver ramp (earn 31 gold)
Pay 19 gold for three bundles of leather-grip lacing (+3 scraps)
Walk beneath the shoehorn and leave the crossing to the cobbler
